created: 2026-09-13 evening (the multi-observer control: dw-8ray seen by five observers)
description: Identical to dw-8ray (2 discs, radius 1.0, 10 rays cast / 8 kept per view, no position noise, no observation noise, 40 frames, fixed reflectivities, open boundary, 20M training sequences, matched Transformer-L recipe) in TWO coupled fields. (1) FIVE observers instead of one: observer k is the canonical observer rotated about the pivot (0, 7.5) — the frustum's depth midpoint — by 2*pi*k/5, so each sits 7.5 from the pivot looking at it; the observation is the five 8-ray views concatenated observer-major (40 values). (2) The discs live in the CIRCLE of radius 4.5 about the pivot, which every observer's near and far planes are tangent to (region='circle'); sequences are accepted only if both discs stay fully inside it (the stay-inside analogue of always_in_frustum). Consequence accepted by Sevan: a disc is outside a given observer's kept fan ~7% of the time (never outside all five). Purpose (Sevan, 2026-09-13): position is more determined (as with anti-aliasing) but through a different pressure — integrating partial views — and the 8-ray output is five times wider again: does the categorical read-out still edit at +0.5..0.6 when the output is 40-dimensional? Read-outs: Cartesian regression basis (the frustum basis is observer-0-relative and no longer privileged); per-observer factorised appearance (5 centre+length pairs per disc).
